title: Nourishing French Beef Bouillabaisse
description: A hearty, briny, and snappy post-workout French dish featuring a rich beef broth, tender vegetables, and succulent fish. Perfect for a comforting dinner after a long day.
instructions: Season beef neck bones with salt and pepper, and seal in a sous-vide bag with 1 cup of red wine. Cook for 24 hours.
Soak fennel and onion in cold water for 30 minutes, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté chopped fennel and onion in olive oil until tender, about 20 minutes.
Add garlic, cinnamon, bay leaves, and thyme to the pot, and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in anchovy paste and tomato paste, and cook for 1 minute.
Add fish stock and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a large pot, discarding solids.
Add cooked beef neck bones to the pot, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add mussels and clams to the pot, and cook until shells open, about 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with crusty bread and a squeeze of lemon.
Tear crusty bread into bite-sized pieces and serve on the side, for dipping into the broth.
